Brazil single- and double-asterisk scope notes explain self-declared census categories without declaring peoples extinct or turning linguistic families into governments.
Named composite resource binds all participating profile IDs and is suppressed under their publication holds.
Directory-only holds apply to public entries and font roles, exclude automatic research planning and reject claim; no automatic restoration is added.

About, hub, credits and footer captions distinguish automated phrase matching, separate source/meaning review and person checks backed by dated receipts. No blanket human-check claim remains in these revised captions.
